body_markdown:
Robertson and Mentz


Canterbury Park’s 32nd season of live racing concluded Saturday showing gains in attendance and on-track wagering during the 50-day meet. Mac Robertson won his 17th thoroughbred training title finishing the meet with 49 wins and $995,567 in purse earnings. Manuel Americano, riding this season for the first time at the Shakopee, Minn. racetrack, was the leading rider with 76 wins and $1,490,821 in purses. Americano won two races Saturday. John Mentz of Lakeville was leading owner with 27 winners from a meet leading 106 starts.


Daily attendance averaged 5,234, an increase of 9% over 2025. Daily average handle was up 5%.


Frosty View was voted Horse of the Meet for the second consecutive season. The 5-year-old Minnesota bred finished the meet winning three of five


Americano


starts including the Brooks Fields Mile and the Ralph Strangis Allowance. Frosty View (pictured above) is owned by Charlene Gabler and is trained by Joel Berndt. Frosty View was also voted Older Horse and Grass Horse of the Meet. Berndt trained Sprinter of the Meet Street Warrior and the Three-Year-Old of the Meet That Type Ofa Deal, who won the final race of season, as well.


Wagering handle on Saturday for the nine-race card was $1,209,106.


Canterbury Park officials expect to run a similar schedule in 2027 and will submit a dates application to the Minnesota Racing Commission later this Fall.


**By The Numbers**


2026 average attendance: 5,234


2026 total handle: $39,687,516


2026 daily average on track handle: $148,880


2026 daily average out-of-state handle: $644,870


Unique thoroughbred starters: 650


Total races: 377


**Canterbury Park’s 2026 Horse of the Meet and divisional champions:**


• **Horse of the Meet** – Frosty View (owner: Charlene Gabler : trainer: Joel Berndt)


• **Sprinter** – Street Warrior (owner: Suzanne Stables : trainer: Joel Berndt)


• **Older Horse** – Frosty View (owner: Charlene Gabler : trainer: Joel Berndt)


• **Older Filly or Mare** – Thunders Rocknroll (owner: Bob Lindgren : trainer: Patrick Swan)


• **Grass Horse** – Frosty View (owner: Charlene Gabler : trainer: Joel Berndt)


• T **hree-Year-Old Colt or Gelding** – That Type Ofa Deal (owner: Suzanne Stables : trainer: Joel Berndt)


• **Three-Year-Old Filly** – Summer Winner (owner: Pete Mattson & Tim Padilla : trainer: Tim Padilla)


• **Two-Year-Old** – Rhyme Away (owner: Carin Offerman : trainer: Troy Bethke)


• **Claimer** – Rose View (owner: Charles Nielsen: trainer: Jose Silva, Jr.)


• **Quarter Horse** – Sheza a Sugar Momma (owner: Tom Maher and Paul Luedemann : trainer: Jason Olmstead )


**Leading Thoroughbred Jockey:** Manuel Americano 76 wins


**Leading Thoroughbred Trainer:** Mac Robertson 49 wins


**Leading Thoroughbred Owner:** John Mentz 27 wins


**Leading Quarter Horse Jockey:** Ryder Olmstead 10 wins


**Leading Quarter Horse Trainer:** Jason Olmstead 15 wins


**Leading Quarter Horse Owners:** Tom Maher & Paul Luedemann; Cesar Albino Martinez; Cavenaugh Quarter Horses, LLC; Tom Maher 3 wins
